routes.description: Import PDF content as editable Word objects or rendered page images with diagnostics.
routes.textFormattingContract: Reconstructs supported text and formatting from PDF logical or positioned content; it cannot recover source-only font semantics absent from the PDF.

routes.knownLimitations: Editable mode reconstructs supported logical content; scans need OCR and exact layout is not preserved. Visual mode embeds page images within the managed renderer's support and resource limits; text and interactive objects are not editable.

routes.description: Import detected PDF tables into an editable workbook with diagnostics.

routes.description: Reconstruct supported PDF content as native slide objects, or select explicit visual, hybrid, and tables-only projections with diagnostics.

routes.description: Reconstruct PDF logical content as Markdown with explicit fixed-layout loss diagnostics.
